title: Thought it was wider
text: Thought it was wider. I like the color and mesh design however I thought it was wider than this. I can't complain though because I do think I got my money's worth hence why I kept it. Works great! I have some boots in there and they have stayed perfectly. I can't shut my door with this on there but that's okay.

product_metadata.title: Gorilla Grip Shoe Holder Rack for Over the Door, 24 Mesh Pockets Hold up to 40 Lbs, Back of Closet Organizer, Behind Door Hanger, Nonslip Holders, Shoes, Sneakers Home Accessories, 2 Pack Hunter Green
features: Holds More Weight: unlike many other over the door organizers, this 24 pocket organizer can hold up to 40 pounds of items; made from durable non-woven fabric, it features thick stitching that is rip and tear resistant; designed to last with all of your shoes, sneakers and more
Slip Resistant Design : organizer features four strong and sturdy hooks that firmly grip the top of doors and are designed to fit seamlessly over most doors

Breathable Mesh Pockets: each pocket has breathable mesh that holds your items in, while letting them breathe, helping to prevent odors and dust on your items; plus, the pockets allow for easy access to your items; you’ll always know where everything is thanks to the 100 percent visibility

Not Just for Shoes: measures 64 by 19 inches with each pocket measuring 7.8 by 4.3 inches, a superior choice for storing nearly anything; easily store crafting supplies, pantry items, beauty items, or household cleaning supplies in a highly organized and efficient manner; organizer can fit over most doors so you can easily place it not only in closets, but in mudrooms, bathrooms, garages, and more

No Hardware Required: lightweight and easy to hang nearly anywhere since they require no hardware to setup; no more big storage bins that take up more space; they are also collapsible and simple to fold, so you can store them when not in use, or even bring with you on vacations away from home to help keep your things organized
